resolution: Depth-coded vertex dots now colour by the view's dominant WORLD axis (anchored at world origin) instead of raw camera-space depth. The compass top view deliberately clamps at ~86° pitch (Y-up pole is degenerate), so even dial-snapped views sit off axis — the snap makes same-world-coordinate = same-colour exactly, from any near-axis or free-orbit view, and the palette no longer swims with the camera. Compass clamp itself untouched (by design). Zig change — needs a dev-host rebuild to show.
